newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-HOLLIOAKE BROTHERS NAMED IN ENGLAND SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-HOLLIOAKE BROTHERS NAMED IN ENGLAND SQUAD.

text.p: Ben Hollioake, 19, and his elder brother Adam were named on Sunday in England's 13-man squad for the fifth test against Australia at Trent Bridge starting on Thursday.
Both Surrey players have yet to win their first test caps.

Squad: Mike Atherton (captain), Alec Stewart, John Crawley, Nasser Hussain, Graham Thorpe, Adam Hollioake, Ben Hollioake, Robert Croft, Andy Caddick, Darren Gough, Dean Headley, Devon Malcolm, Phil Tufnell.
